title: My first game "Novorsk", a top-down extraction shooter
author: ToG_040

comments.author: fisj
comments.body: Can you explain how you used generative AI in this game? Please see Rule #4.

replies.author: ToG_040
replies.body:
Sure. I’m happy to clarify.

I used generative AI for some of the item sprite artwork in the game. Most item icons were initially created using an image generation model, then manually edited, cleaned up, resized, and integrated by me to fit the game’s style.

https://i.redd.it/yd1vpodj4rhg1.gif
